orientation_excerpt: It is a **complete working reference for the current Suno V6 ecosystem**: what the tools are, where they live, what they are good for, how they interact, how to troubleshoot them, how to test them scientifically, and where the boundaries of the evidence are.
changes: Selected V6-oriented wording and method notes; added English explanatory adaptations and evidence limits. Excluded the unsubstantiated Audio Quality Rescue recipe. No independent effect testing. Source orientation and record-level model basis reviewed for the 0.4 V6 core; targeting is not test evidence. Foundation expansion 2026-10-27: selected missing vocabulary and scoped guidance; retained uncertainty, field distinctions and negation/tempo limitations. Previous selection archived; no independent effects verified.
